notes.gloss: marked by or showing unaffected simplicity and lack of guile or worldly experience
notes.note: The French spelling, used when the writer wants a touch of distance.
Dejection by monotony — it flattens rather than darkens, dispiriting without the menace of *grim*.

notes.gloss: in a more fortunate or prosperous condition
notes.note: Comparative by construction - it always implies something being compared against, and never says what.
Says only that reform will not work - a practical judgement, without *irredeemable*'s sense of a soul that cannot be saved.

notes.gloss: made of inferior workmanship and materials
notes.note: Cheap stuff cheaply made, the whole thing called trash, where *shoddy* is about poor work pretending to be solid.

notes.gloss: ill-mannered and coarse and contemptible in behavior or appearance
